turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Mr. Reddy, how are you doing? This is your nephew Arjun calling from Bengaluru.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, Arjun! I was wondering when you would call. I am doing fine, but my knees are bothering me again.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is just the weather changing. Are you still taking the medicine the doctor gave you last month?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, but sometimes I forget if I took it in the morning. It is very confusing now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dont worry, I will bring a pill organizer for you when I visit during the next festival.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That would be very helpful. When are you planning to come home?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am looking at flights for next week. I want to spend a few days with you and the cousins.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: The children will be so happy. Will you bring those sweets from the city?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course, I will bring plenty. By the way, I sent twelve thousand rupees to your account for the house repairs we discussed.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand? You should have kept that money for your own expenses, beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is okay, uncle. Just use it to get the leak in the roof fixed before the heavy rains start.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright then, I will talk to the contractor tomorrow. I am glad you called today.
